p: affliction by the rod of his: The prophet complains of the punishments and afflictions that he endured by the false prophets and hypocrites when he declared the destruction of Jerusalem, as in Jer 20:1,2.
built against me: He speaks this as one that felt God's heavy judgment, which he greatly feared, and therefore sets them out with this diversity of words.

prayer: This is a great temptation for the godly when they do not see the fruit of their prayers and causes them to think that they are not heard, which thing God uses so that they might pray more earnestly and often.
inclosed my ways with hewn stone: And keeps me in hold as a prisoner.
He was to me as a: He has no pity on me.
wormwood: With great anguish and sorrow he has made me lose my sense.
hope hath perished from the LORD: Thus with pain he was driven to and fro between hope and despair, as the godly often are, yet in the end the spirit gets the victory.
in me: He shows that God thus uses to exercise his, to the intent that by this they may know themselves, and feel his mercies.

mercies that we are not consumed: Considering the wickedness of man it is a marvel that any remains alive: but only that God for his own mercies sake and for his promise will ever have his Church remain, though they are never so few in number, Isa 1:9.
every morning: We feel your benefits daily.
portion: The godly put their whole confidence in God, and therefore look for no other inheritance, as Ps 16:5.
youth: He shows that we can never begin too soon to be exercised under the cross, that when the afflictions grow greater, our patience also by experience may be stronger.
and keepeth silence: He murmurs not against God, but is patient.
mouth in the dust: He humbles himself as they who fall down with their face to the ground, and so with patience waits for comfort.
afflict willingly nor grieve the children: He takes no pleasure in it, but does it of necessity for our amendment, when he permits the wicked to oppress the poor.
approveth not: He does not delight in it.
commandeth it not: He shows that nothing is done without God's providence.
evil and good: That is, adversity and prosperity, Am 3:6.
man complain: When God afflicts him.
our heart with our hands to: That is, both hearts and hands: for else to lift up the hands is but hypocrisy.
affecteth my heart because of all: I am overcome with sore weeping for all my people.
in the dungeon: Read Jer 37:16 how he was in the miry dungeon.
soul: Meaning, the reason his life was in danger.
